checkpoint: 4 — the checks red on demand, one mutant per independent part of the cure
commitUnderMutation: the cure commit: 243b8ab as measured, 558c193 after the rebase onto origin/main 19013ae — same tree, the rebase only moved the parent
note: Every mutation was applied to the committed tree, run, and reverted with `git checkout -- <file>`. The control run on the unmutated tree is at the end; without it the red runs below prove nothing.

mutations.what: The measured limit is neutered: $script:GodotMaximumEnterableDirectoryPathLength = 254 becomes 4096 in scripts/GodotTools.ps1, so no profile is ever refused.
mutations.firstLine: A profile that made the engine print 1 shader cache errors was accepted, or was refused without naming the count, the engine line and the fix.

mutations.what: The limit is moved by one character: 254 becomes 253 in scripts/GodotTools.ps1.
mutations.firstLine: The shader cache path budget no longer flips between 254 and 255 characters: 254 accepted=False, 255 accepted=False.
mutations.reading: The boundary is held to the character, not to an order of magnitude. This is the mutation that keeps the guard honest in the direction that costs something: an over-strict budget would refuse runs that work.

mutations.what: The model of the path Godot builds is broken: $script:GodotShaderCacheHashLength = 64 becomes 32 in scripts/GodotTools.ps1.
mutations.firstLine: At APPDATA length 92 the budget says 0 shader classes are unenterable; the machine measured 1 engine error lines.
mutations.reading: The staircase in the test is the machine's measurement, not the code's own arithmetic restated, so a wrong path model is caught even though the limit itself is untouched.

mutations.part: one way of choosing the temporary directory
mutations.what: The difference of Issue #184 is put back: the three lines that resolve the shared temporary root are deleted from scripts/run-game.ps1, so it stops honouring -TemporaryRoot and DUNGEON_FORTRESS_TEMP while verify.ps1 keeps honouring them.
mutations.firstLine: 'run-game.ps1' starts the engine without choosing the temporary directory the shared way. That is the divergence of Issue #184: verify.ps1 honoured -TemporaryRoot and DUNGEON_FORTRESS_TEMP and run-game.ps1 did not, so the same capture ran against two different Godot runtime profiles and only one of them was over the shader cache path limit.
mutations.reading: This is the mutation the brief asked for by name: return the difference, see the check go red.

mutations.part: the diagnosis attached to the engine lines
mutations.what: Get-GodotShaderCachePathDiagnosis stops recognising the lines: its match over the output is replaced with an empty collection in scripts/GodotTools.ps1.
mutations.firstLine: The GLES3 shader cache lines are reported without naming what they mean, which is the state Issue #184 was opened in.

theTwoEntryPointsNowAgree.why: A structural check says the scripts choose the directory the same way. This is the behaviour behind it, measured rather than argued.
